errata: S4 and SigmaPhi on p.103 declare nSats+1 bytes, but their f4 array fields require 4*nSats+1. The codecs follow the field declarations.
Single spectrum Sp on p.119 omits n from its size expression. The codecs use 8+n*m*2 payload bytes plus the optional 33-byte extension.
sj on p.130 is absent from the table of contents and is included here.
SvDelay on p.119 refers to the immediately preceding SvDelays record.
IRNSS ephemeris IE p.112 is 124 bytes and embeds the required 122-byte GPS ephemeris data, followed by navType and checksum.
QZSS QE follows the GPS ephemeris optional block, including its CNAV2 layout; the declared QZSS length list omits the extended 168-byte form.
